objectives: Pupils will understand how dinosaurs adapted to their environments.

requiredKnowledge: Dinosaurs had straight back legs positioned perpendicular to their bodies.
Straight back legs allowed dinosaurs to use less energy to move than reptiles with sprawling stances.
The Ornithischia had a flexible lower-jaw joint.
The flexible lower-jaw joint was an adaptation to eating plants and helped the dinosaurs grind vegetable food.
Dinosaurs had two holes behind the eye socket.
Two holes behind the eye socket let strong jaw muscles attach directly to the top of the skull, so the jaws could open wide and clamp down with more force.
